context: Asuka lectures on Earth and energy.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science lecture; physics vocabulary (地球/得る/エネルギー/空間) seeded in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地球は、太陽からエネルギーを得ます。
lines.en: Earth gains energy from the sun.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そのエネルギーは、どこへ行くんですか?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 植物が、それを得て成長します。
lines.en: Plants take it in and grow.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 宇宙の空間は、どこまで広いんですか?
lines.en: How far does the space of the universe extend?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 空間は、想像を超えて広がっています。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 人の脳は、それを理解できるんですか?
lines.en: Can the human brain understand it?
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 脳は、少しずつ知識を得ていきます。
lines.en: The brain gains knowledge little by little.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 地球も脳も、不思議だらけですね。
lines.en: Both Earth and the brain are full of mysteries.
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm wonder delivery throughout
